style_prefix_exact:
Assess only the human-sounding naturalness of these two essay excerpts. Neither is privileged as a source or original. Do not infer actual authorship or detector scores. Do not score semantic fidelity in this stage. Judge the writing as a reader, including the relationships between thoughts, pacing, voice, and rhetorical effects. Clear, short, polished prose is not automatically more natural; a long sentence is not automatically worse. Do not penalize a version merely because it changes syntax or point of view compared with the other. Return JSON with X and Y objects containing voice_score_1_to_5 and prose_comment, plus preference X/Y/TIE and why.
HEADING:
function_prefix: Review only whether the proposed deletion preserves the actual thought and useful rhetorical function in this excerpt. Do not score human-sounding style, authorship or detector outcomes, and do not fact-check the author's beliefs against external knowledge. Protect independent claims, qualifications, causality, agency, action-changing conditions, humor, callbacks, and needed orientation. Do not protect a sentence just because it is in the original: repeated explanations or realization scaffolding may be removed when the same intended thought remains unambiguous. Conversely, calling a qualification a hedge does not establish that it is dispensable. Consider the strongest ordinary reading of the author's source. Minor capitalization/punctuation cleanup after a deletion is not a substantive loss. Judge this exact proposed cut, not a larger rewrite. Return JSON only with recommendation KEEP/CUT/UNCERTAIN, material_function_lost true/false/null, functions_retained array, functions_lost array, exact_supporting_words array, and why.
